Moreover, kids are introduced to people from various service sectors, ranging from doctors and postmen to vegetable sellers. These interactions broaden their horizons and foster a deeper understanding of the world around them.

I witnessed the remarkable transformation of my 2-year-old during her time at Safari Kid. From being initially hesitant and tearful, she blossomed into a confident performer, captivating the audience at the school's annual day.

I am deeply grateful to the entire team at Safari Kid, especially Nishka, the principal, and the dedicated class teachers, Mansha, and Avantika. Your guidance and support have made a profound impact on my child's journey.

I wholeheartedly recommend this school to all parents seeking a nurturing environment for their little ones.
Thank you, Safari Kid!
